eventMapping.description: Translates each network's own status strings into FLOX statuses: CPA_HOLD / CPA_ACCEPT / CPA_REDEP / CPA_DECLINE / CPA_TRASH.
eventMapping.cardDescription: Raw status string this network sends → FLOX status.
eventMapping.emptyMappings: No mappings yet — unmapped statuses fall through unrecognized.
eventMapping.noNetworks: No networks yet — add one on the Networks page first.

incoming.description: Give each network its URL — with the network's secret, shown once when the network is created. Each status is recorded once per click (a redeposit once per transaction id) unless the network has "Accept duplicate postbacks" on. Status strings are translated through Event Mapping.
incoming.noNetworks: No networks yet — add one on the Networks page first.
incoming.noTracker: The tracker address is not set — there is no URL to show.
incoming.setupLink: Parameters and statuses for the network →

outgoing.description: FLOX calls a network's postback URL whenever a conversion status changes for that network. Managed here and on the Networks page — they're the same data.

logs.emptyDescription: Every incoming and outgoing postback attempt is logged here, success or not.
logs.title: Postback logs
